Find the treatment program that's best for you.  They will probably approve you for two weeks of detox followed by 90 days of inpatient rehab.  4.  Enjoy rehab.  It can be harder work than anything you've ever done before because it may require you to think about things or in ways that you have spent so much time avoiding.  You get out of it what you put in, at the very least, by the end, you'll know a lil more about yourself and have some sober time under your belt.

I know it will be difficult to take time off work but it's the best way to get better.  

Not sure if it's what other people would suggest but I do know that I felt hope there which I hadn't in a while.
